en: 2. Khandhayamaka 2.1 Paṇṇattivāra 2.1.2.
Exposition of the Section on Designations (Paṇṇattivāraniddesa)
2.1.2.1. Chapter on the Purification of Terms (Padasodhanavāra) 2.1.2.1.1.
Positive Order (Anuloma):
Is material form (rūpa) the aggregate of material form (rūpakkhandha)?
A form that is pleasant and agreeable is not the aggregate of form. The aggregate of form is both form and the aggregate of form.
Is the aggregate of form form? Yes.
Is feeling the aggregate of feeling? Yes.
Is the aggregate of feeling feeling? Yes.
Is perception perception?
Perception that is view is perception, but not the aggregate of perception. The aggregate of perception is both perception and the aggregate of perception.
Is the aggregate of perception "perception"? Yes.
Are formations "the aggregate of formations"?
With the exception of the aggregate of formations, the remaining formations are not the aggregate of formations; the aggregate of formations is both formations and the aggregate of formations.
Is the aggregate of mental formations (saṅkhārakkhandha) "formations" (saṅkhāra)? Yes.
Is consciousness (viññāṇa) the aggregate of consciousness (viññāṇakkhandha)? Yes.
Is the aggregate of consciousness "consciousness"? Yes.
2.1.2.1.2. Negative (Paccanīka) Is it not form, yet not the aggregate of form? Yes.
Is it not the aggregate of form, yet not form? Yes.

That which is pleasant in form and agreeable in form is not the aggregate of form, yet it is form. Excluding both form and the aggregate of form, the remainder is neither form nor the aggregate of form.
Is it not feeling, and not the aggregate of feeling? Yes.
Is it not the aggregate of feeling, and not feeling? Yes.
Is it not perception, yet not the aggregate of perception? Yes.
Is it not the aggregate of perception, yet not perception?

Wrong-view perception is not the aggregate of perception, but it is perception. Excluding both perception and the aggregate of perception, the remainder is neither perception nor the aggregate of perception.
Are they not formations (saṅkhāra) and yet not the formation aggregate (saṅkhārakkhandha)? Yes.
Are they not the formation aggregate and yet not formations?

With the exception of the formation aggregate, the remainder are not the formation aggregate, but they are formations. With the exception of both formations and the formation aggregate, the remainder are neither formations nor the formation aggregate.
Is it not consciousness that is not the aggregate of consciousness? Yes.
Is it not the aggregate of consciousness that is not consciousness? Yes.
2.1.2.2. Wheel-Section on the Basis of Purification of Terms.
2.1.2.2.1. Positive Order.
Is form the form aggregate?
That which is agreeable form and pleasant form is form, but not the form aggregate. The form aggregate is both form and the form aggregate.
Are the aggregates the feeling aggregate?
The feeling aggregate is both an aggregate and the feeling aggregate.
The remaining aggregates are not the feeling aggregate.
Is form the aggregate of form?
That which is agreeable form, pleasant form, is form but not the aggregate of form. The aggregate of form is both form and the aggregate of form.
Are the aggregates the aggregate of perception?
The aggregate of perception is both an aggregate and the aggregate of perception. The remaining aggregates are aggregates but not the aggregate of perception.
Is form the aggregate of form?
Pleasant form and agreeable form are form, but not the aggregate of form. The aggregate of form is both form and the aggregate of form.
Are aggregates the formations-aggregate?
The formations-aggregate is both an aggregate and the formations-aggregate; the remaining aggregates are aggregates but not the formations-aggregate.
Is form the form-aggregate?
Form that is pleasant and agreeable is not the form aggregate. The form aggregate is both form and the form aggregate.
Are the aggregates the consciousness aggregate?
The consciousness aggregate is both an aggregate and the consciousness aggregate; the remaining aggregates are not the consciousness aggregate.

The consciousness-aggregate is both an aggregate and the consciousness-aggregate; the remaining aggregates are aggregates but not the consciousness-aggregate.
Is perception the aggregate of perception?
Perception associated with views is perception, but not the aggregate of perception. The aggregate of perception is both perception and the aggregate of perception.
Are the aggregates the aggregate of form?
The aggregate of form is both an aggregate and the aggregate of form. The remaining aggregates are aggregates but not the aggregate of form.
Is perception perception-aggregate?
Wrong-view-perception is perception, but not the perception-aggregate. The perception-aggregate is both perception and the perception-aggregate.
Are aggregates the feeling aggregate?
The feeling aggregate is both an aggregate and the feeling aggregate. The remaining aggregates are aggregates but not the feeling aggregate.
Is perception the perception aggregate?
Perception of views is perception, but it is not the perception aggregate. The perception aggregate is both perception and the perception aggregate.
Are the aggregates the formations aggregate?
The formations aggregate is both an aggregate and the formations aggregate; the remaining aggregates are not the formations aggregate.
Is perception the aggregate of perception?
Perception associated with views is perception, but not the aggregate of perception. The aggregate of perception is both perception and the aggregate of perception.
Are the aggregates the aggregate of consciousness?
The consciousness aggregate is both an aggregate and the consciousness aggregate. The remaining aggregates are aggregates but not the consciousness aggregate.
Are volitional formations the volitional formations aggregate?

With the exception of the volitional formations aggregate, the remaining volitional formations are volitional formations but not the volitional formations aggregate. The volitional formations aggregate is both volitional formations and the volitional formations aggregate.
Are the aggregates (khandhā) the aggregate of form (rūpakkhandho)?
The aggregate of form is both an aggregate and the aggregate of form. The remaining aggregates are aggregates but not the aggregate of form.
Are volitional formations (saṅkhārā) the aggregate of volitional formations (saṅkhārakkhandho)?

Excluding the aggregate of volitional formations (*saṅkhārakkhandha*), the remaining formations are formations but not the aggregate of volitional formations. The aggregate of volitional formations is both formations and the aggregate of volitional formations.
Are the aggregates the aggregate of feeling (*vedanākkhandha*)?
The aggregate of feeling is both an aggregate and the aggregate of feeling; the remaining aggregates are aggregates but not the aggregate of feeling.
Are volitional formations (saṅkhārā) the aggregate of volitional formations (saṅkhārakkhandha)?

With the exception of the aggregate of volitional formations, the remaining volitional formations are not the aggregate of volitional formations. The aggregate of volitional formations is both volitional formations and the aggregate of volitional formations.
Are the aggregates the aggregate of perception (saññākkhandha)?
The aggregate of perception is both an aggregate and the aggregate of perception. The remaining aggregates are not the aggregate of perception.
Are volitional formations the aggregate of volitional formations?

With the exception of the aggregate of volitional formations, the remaining volitional formations are not the aggregate of volitional formations. The aggregate of volitional formations is both volitional formations and the aggregate of volitional formations.
Are aggregates the consciousness-aggregate?
The consciousness-aggregate is both an aggregate and the consciousness-aggregate; the remaining aggregates are aggregates but not the consciousness-aggregate.
Is consciousness the consciousness-aggregate? Yes.
Are the aggregates the form aggregate?
The form aggregate is both an aggregate and the form aggregate; the remaining aggregates are aggregates but not the form aggregate.
Is consciousness the consciousness aggregate? Yes.
Are the aggregates the feeling aggregate?
The feeling aggregate is both an aggregate and the feeling aggregate. The remaining aggregates are aggregates but not the feeling aggregate.
Is consciousness the consciousness aggregate? Yes.
Are aggregates the perception aggregate?
The perception aggregate is both an aggregate and the perception aggregate. The remaining aggregates are not the perception aggregate.
Is consciousness the consciousness aggregate? Yes.
Are aggregates the formations aggregate?
The formations aggregate is both an aggregate and the formations aggregate. The remaining aggregates are not the formations aggregate.

2.1.2.3. Chapter on Pure Aggregates. 2.1.2.3.1.
Positive Order.
Is form an aggregate? Yes. Are aggregates the form-aggregate?
The form-aggregate is both an aggregate and the form-aggregate; the remaining aggregates are aggregates but not the form-aggregate.
Is it the aggregate of feeling? Yes.
Are the aggregates the aggregate of feeling?
The aggregate of feeling is both an aggregate and the aggregate of feeling; the remaining aggregates are aggregates but not the aggregate of feeling.
Is perception an aggregate? Yes.
Are aggregates perception-aggregates?
The perception-aggregate is both an aggregate and a perception-aggregate; the remaining aggregates are aggregates but not perception-aggregates.
Are formations (saṅkhārā) an aggregate (khandha)? Yes.
Are aggregates the aggregate of formations (saṅkhārakkhandha)?
The aggregate of formations is both an aggregate and the aggregate of formations; the remaining aggregates are aggregates but not the aggregate of formations.
Is consciousness a aggregate? Yes.
Are aggregates consciousness-aggregates?
The consciousness-aggregate is both an aggregate and a consciousness-aggregate; the remaining aggregates are aggregates but not consciousness-aggregates.
2.1.2.3.2. Negative (Paccanīka) Is it not matter and not an aggregate?
With the exception of matter, the remaining aggregates are not matter, but they are aggregates. With the exception of both matter and the aggregates, the remainder are neither matter nor aggregates.
Are they not aggregates, yet not the aggregate of form? Yes.
Are they not feeling, yet not an aggregate?

With the exception of feeling, the remaining aggregates are not feeling, but they are aggregates. With the exception of both feeling and the aggregates, the remainder are neither feeling nor aggregates.
Are they not aggregates, yet not the feeling aggregate? Yes.
Are they not perception, yet not an aggregate?

With the exception of perception, the remaining aggregates are not perception, but they are aggregates. With the exception of both perception and the aggregates, the remainder are neither perception nor aggregates.
Are they not aggregates, yet not the perception aggregate? Yes.
Are they not formations, yet not an aggregate? Yes.
Are they not aggregates, yet not the formation aggregate? Yes.
Is it not consciousness and not an aggregate?

With the exception of consciousness, the remaining aggregates are not consciousness, but they are aggregates. With the exception of both consciousness and the aggregates, the remainder is neither consciousness nor an aggregate.
Is it not an aggregate and not the consciousness-aggregate? Yes.
